claim_text: Current Minnesota reporting identifies Mahamoud Warsame, associated with Metro Area Catering, as the 80th person charged in the Feeding Our Future investigation. Sahan Journal's updated defendant roster says he was charged on July 22, 2026 via a felony information with one count of wire fraud, and Center of the American Experiment reports the case number as 26-cr-135. The underlying federal Information/docket has not yet been captured in this corpus, so the charge identity and ordinal are SECONDARY_VERIFIED rather than primary-court-record verified. The alleged fraud conduct itself remains a charging allegation, not an adjudicated fact.

supporting_passages.quote: charged with one count of wire fraud

qualifiers: Primary federal Information/docket not yet captured; supersede this source basis when the court record is retrieved
